title: crepis lignea
intro: Crepis lignea, commonly known as Burnet saxifrage, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is used in herbal medicine for its purported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepis lignea include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and potentially lowering blood sugar levels. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
